negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: PR prose is updated while canonical documentation remains wrong.

negative_controls.observed: Only the edited status matrix held the old exact phrase.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: BRL and USD are summed into one scalar aggregate.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Mixed currencies collapse into one result.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Summing before grouping creates a false single-currency total.

negative_controls.observed: FIN-E2E-007 sees BRL and USD blocks and no scalar aggregate.

source_texts: Criar uma suíte de cenários ponta a ponta que valide invariantes financeiros de alto risco independentemente da implementação interna.
requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: A partial or order-dependent happy-path suite misses duplicate, leak, retry, clock, or fixture-contamination defects.

negative_controls.failure_mode: One or more of the nine issue scenarios is absent or the suite contaminates later integration tests.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: A partial or state-leaking suite can pass its own assertions while breaking the automated gate.
negative_controls.procedure: Run FIN-E2E-001 through FIN-E2E-009, then guarantee scoped cleanup in finally before the next integration test.
negative_controls.expected: All nine scenarios are represented and fixture state is removed regardless of pass/fail.
negative_controls.observed: The exact-material suite contains all nine FIN-E2E cases and a tenant/profile-scoped FK-safe finally cleanup.

negative_controls.failure_mode: A financial effect is duplicated or omitted.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Absolute seeded totals can hide duplicate accounting effects.
negative_controls.procedure: Compare immediate pre/post summary deltas for mutations.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Profile A leaks deliberately distinct sibling profile B values.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Organization-only filtering can leak sibling financial profile rows.
negative_controls.procedure: Create profile A USD 1700 and sibling profile B USD 900000; query profile A and prove exclusion.
negative_controls.observed: FIN-E2E-008 returns only profile A USD 1700; sibling profile B is excluded, and cleanup is scoped to both fixture profiles.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Retry creates a second invoice payment effect.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Late state validation can persist a duplicate payment.
negative_controls.procedure: Pay once, snapshot count and summary, retry, then compare both.
negative_controls.observed: FIN-E2E-009 preserves paymentTransactionId, linked-row count and currencyBlocks across the rejected retry.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Runner wall clock changes financial expectations.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Using current time makes the suite calendar dependent.
negative_controls.procedure: Use literal occurred, planned, effective, and reference dates.
negative_controls.observed: FIN-E2E scenarios use fixed 2040-2048 financial dates.

risk_surfaces.reason: Financial effects must occur exactly once.
Nine issue scenarios must stay represented and the suite must remain order-independent.
Sibling profile data must be excluded.
Payment retry must not duplicate effects.
Financial dates must be fixed literals.

source_texts: estorno/reembolso preservando rastreabilidade e sinal correto;
requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Void deletes the row, flips sign, or leaves expense counted.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Void loses traceability or keeps expense effect.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Deleting or opposite-sign duplication can fake a balance check.
negative_controls.procedure: Create expense, void same id, reload, compare baseline.
negative_controls.observed: FIN-E2E-005 keeps identity voided and returns to baseline.

risk_surfaces.reason: Void must preserve trace and remove effect.
